name: springmass-expert-v3
note: Lesson 2 expert built from scratch: the Springmass starter history plus the expert build, block by block (Crate only)
expected:
[when green flag clicked]
[set (springstiffness) to (10)]
[set mass to (1) kg]
[set (initialdisplacement) to (0.2)]
[set DeltaT to (0.1)]
[set x_position to (initialdisplacement)]
[set x_velocity to (0)]
[set (time) to (0)]
[set x net force to ((-1) (×) ((springstiffness) (×) (x_position))) N]
[set x_acceleration to ((x net force in N) (/) (mass in kg))]
[set (potentialenergy) to (((springstiffness) (×) ((x_position) (power) (2))) (/) (2))]
[set (kineticenergy) to (((mass in kg) (×) ((x_velocity) (power) (2))) (/) (2))]
[start simulation]

[simulation step]
[set x net force to ((-1) (×) ((springstiffness) (×) (x_position))) N]
[set x_acceleration to ((x net force in N) (/) (mass in kg))]
[change x_velocity by ((x_acceleration) (×) (DeltaT))]
[change x_position by ((x_velocity) (×) (DeltaT))]
[set (potentialenergy) to (((springstiffness) (×) ((x_position) (power) (2))) (/) (2))]
[set (kineticenergy) to (((mass in kg) (×) ((x_velocity) (power) (2))) (/) (2))]
[change (time) by (DeltaT)]
[if ((8) (<) (time))]
	[stop simulation]
